summary: The installer checks your Azure region first, and private installs keep their Key Vault private.

fixes.title: Installer checks the Azure region first
fixes.text: The installer checks that the chosen Azure region accepts new resources before it creates anything.

fixes.title: Private Key Vault stays private
fixes.text: A private install keeps its Key Vault private, also after a deleted vault is recovered.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The PIM Manager address reaches Invardia from the first update, and every hand-over file is in the checksum list.
